build.buildCommand: cd mk/mk/Fittrack && npm install && npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../django_backend/ && cd ../django_backend && pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: cd mk/mk/Fittrack/django_backend && python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && gunicorn fittrack.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT
